schema_version: 1
name: Batch done notice
note: Run one status command on a timer and report to the owner only when it says the whole batch has ended.
owner: team
inputs:
  batch_status_command:
    type: string
    description: Command printing a single status line for all running work
pipeline:
  trigger:
    type: schedule
    every: 2m
  steps:
  - name: status
    input: text
    run: '{{batch_status_command}}'
    'on':
      failed: stop
  - name: ended
    input: text
    uses: filter
    with:
      pattern: (?m)^all-ended$
      bucket: ended
    'on':
      ended: next
      done: stop
  - name: report
    input: text
    run: echo batch-ended
  result:
    to: owner

schema_version: 1
name: '{{title}}'
note: A single status command covers every job; stay quiet while pending and report once everything has ended.
inputs:
  status_command:
    type: string
    description: Status command printing one line for the whole batch
  title:
    type: string
    description: Short Blueprint name, 3 to 40 characters
  complete_regex:
    type: string
    description: Regex that matches when the batch is complete
watch:
  probe: '{{status_command}}'
  question: is-the-batch-complete
  buckets:
  - pending
  - complete
  matches:
    complete: '{{complete_regex}}'
  until: complete
  timeout: 2h
  routes:
    pending: none
    complete: notify

schema_version: 1
name: '{{name}}'
note: Use one verdict probe for all work; keep `waiting` silent and route only `alldone`.
inputs:
  name:
    type: string
    description: Short Blueprint name, 3 to 40 characters
  all_terminal_pattern:
    type: string
    description: All terminal pattern
  one_verdict_probe:
    type: string
    description: One verdict probe
watch:
  probe: '{{one_verdict_probe}}'
  question: classify-all-work
  buckets:
  - waiting
  - alldone
  matches:
    alldone: '{{all_terminal_pattern}}'
  until: alldone
  timeout: 1h
  routes:
    waiting: none
    alldone: notify

schema_version: 1
name: Cron result poller
note: Poll a scheduled job's latest execution record and tell me when it has completed.
owner: team
inputs:
  cron:
    type: string
    description: Cron name or id
pipeline:
  trigger:
    type: schedule
    every: 1m
  steps:
  - name: last run
    input: text
    run: codeterm cron show '{{cron}}' --json
  - name: completed
    input: text
    uses: filter
    with:
      pattern: '"state":\s*"(finished|succeeded|failed)"'
      bucket: completed
    'on':
      completed: next
      done: stop
  - name: tell
    input: text
    run: echo cron-run-completed
  result:
    to: notify

schema_version: 1
name: Scheduled job {{job}}
note: Follow a scheduled job's current execution and ping me once it completes.
inputs:
  done_regex:
    type: string
    description: Regex marking a completed execution
  job:
    type: string
    description: Scheduled job name or id
watch:
  observe: cron-run:{{job}}
  question: has-the-run-ended
  buckets:
  - running
  - ended
  matches:
    ended: '{{done_regex}}'
  until: ended
  timeout: 4h
  routes:
    running: none
    ended: notify

name: Cron {{cron_name_or_id}}

schema_version: 1
name: Dev listener check
note: Hit the dev REST listener over HTTP; when it is down, pull the latest traces and notify.
owner: team
inputs:
  listener_url:
    type: string
    description: Local dev REST listener health URL
pipeline:
  trigger: {type: schedule, every: 30s}
  steps:
    - name: listener
      input: text
      uses: http
      with: {url: '{{listener_url}}', timeout_ms: 2000}
      on: {up: stop, down: traces, failed: traces}
    - name: traces
      input: text
      run: codeterm trace recent --limit 5
      on: {done: stop, failed: stop}
  result: {to: notify}

schema_version: 1
name: local-api-guard
note: Monitor the local development API server; grab the latest request traces if it goes away.
watch:
  probe: codeterm rest-api status --json --verbose
  question: what-phase-is-the-server-in
  buckets: [serving, gone]
  matches: {serving: '"phase":\s*"listening"', gone: '"phase":\s*"(stopped|failed|crashed)"'}
  every: 1m
  timeout: 12h
  rearm_on_change: [gone]
  handlers:
    serving: []
    gone:
      - {type: command, parameters: {command: codeterm trace recent --limit 10, label: Latest traces, timeout_ms: 2500}}
      - {type: notify}
    other:
      - {type: escalate, parameters: {target: creator}}
  escalation_timeout_ms: 300000

schema_version: 1
name: dev-run-health
note: Watch the dev REST listener; capture recent flows when it drops.
watch:
  probe: codeterm rest-api status --json
  question: classify-listener-phase
  buckets: [listening, down]
  matches: {listening: '"phase": "listening"', down: '"phase": "(stopped|failed)"'}
  every: 30s
  timeout: 8h
  rearm_on_change: [down]
  handlers:
    listening: []
    down:
      - {type: command, parameters: {command: codeterm trace recent --limit 5, label: Recent flows, timeout_ms: 3000}}
      - {type: notify}
    other:
      - {type: escalate, parameters: {target: creator}}
  escalation_timeout_ms: 600000

schema_version: 1
name: TLS certificate expiry
note: Probe a certificate's expiry date with openssl and warn me two weeks before it lapses.
inputs:
  cert_probe:
    type: string
    description: Read-only openssl command printing valid or expiring for one host
watch:
  probe: '{{cert_probe}}'
  question: is-the-certificate-expiring
  buckets: [valid, expiring]
  matches: {valid: '(?m)^valid$', expiring: '(?m)^expiring$'}
  every: 24h
  until: expiring
  timeout: 366d
  routes:
    valid: none
    expiring: notify

schema_version: 1
name: Dependency audit
note: Run npm audit weekly and notify only if high or critical vulnerabilities show up.
owner: team
inputs:
  project_dir:
    type: string
    description: Node project directory
pipeline:
  trigger: {type: schedule, every: 168h}
  steps:
    - name: audit
      input: text
      run: npm audit --prefix '{{project_dir}}' --json
      on: {done: next, failed: next}
    - name: severe
      input: text
      uses: filter
      with: {pattern: '"(high|critical)":\s*[1-9]', bucket: severe}
      on: {severe: next, done: stop, failed: stop}
    - name: flag
      input: text
      run: echo vulnerable-dependencies
      on: {done: stop, failed: stop}
  result: {to: notify}

schema_version: 1
name: Disk space low

  probe: '{{df_probe}}'
  question: is-disk-space-low
  buckets: [ok, low]
  matches: {ok: '(?m)^ok$', low: '(?m)^low$'}
  every: 10m
  timeout: 30d
  rearm_on_change: [low]
  routes:
    ok: none
    low: notify

schema_version: 1
name: Nightly database backup
note: Dump the database to the backup volume each night and report the archive size.
owner: team
inputs:
  backup_command:
    type: string
    description: Command that writes a compressed database dump
pipeline:
  trigger: {type: schedule, every: 24h}
  steps:
    - name: dump
      input: text

      on: {done: size, failed: stop}

schema_version: 1
name: Standup digest
note: Each morning gather yesterday's commit log and have an agent write a short standup digest for the team.
owner: team
inputs:
  repo_path:
    type: string
    description: Local repository path
pipeline:
  trigger: {type: schedule, every: 24h}
  steps:
    - name: commits
      input: text
      run: git -C '{{repo_path}}' log --since=yesterday --oneline
      on: {done: next, failed: stop}
    - name: digest
      input: text
      uses: agent
      with: {provider: opaque-provider, profile: writer, task: Summarize these commits as a three-line standup update, deadline_ms: 60000, max_tokens: 800, max_turns: 1}
      on: {done: stop, failed: stop}
  result: {to: team}

  - name: compare

    'on':

  result:

  run:
    type: integer
    description: Positive run or pull request ID
  kind:
    type: string
    default: jobs

    enum:

    - jobs
  cadence:
    type: string
    default: 90s
